title: rta-day schedule
description: A day split into blocks (chapters) of items (checkpoints). Every item with a time becomes one LiveSplit segment.

event.description: Shown in the panel title and subtitle.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. All times are relative to this day; hours >= 24 roll into the next day.

venue.description: Subtitle line. Trimmed at ＆/& when long.

blocks.description: Chapters, in order. One chapter is open at a time on the structured board.

end.description: HH:MM. The last item's window ends here.

cost.description: Ignored by the renderer; keep your own notes here.

time.description: A point in time. 24:00 and later mean the next day.

start.description: Start of a range; used as the checkpoint time.

end.description: End of a range. Only the last item of a block uses it.

type.description: Station rows are arrivals: photos taken on the way belong to the station ahead. Omit for sessions and activities, whose photos come after their start.

station.description: With type depart/arrive the row is named `<station>駅`.

to.description: type transfer. The row is named after this.

short.description: Row name. Overrides the generated one; keep it short, the board is narrow.

title.description: Full title. Goes to the caption line when it differs from `short`.

action.description: What you have to do there. Caption only.

session.description: Marks the row as a talk.

avatar.description: Path to a picture, used as the row icon. Relative to the repository root.
